purpose: Independent exact-head review of the ordinary PR1197 and PR1138 integrations with actual published main after PR1112.
inputs: Explicit reviewed previous/original heads, actual main SHA, prepared new head, exact source checkout and development Python; Git objects and tracked bytes are read only.
outputs: Independent full-tree proof, baseline authentication where applicable, focused pytest/JUnit results and public-safe exact receipt copies.
adaptation_details: Reuses the prior independent tree-composition, preserved-path and baseline-authentication criteria with explicit caller-supplied immutable review inputs.
Replaces merge-tree --write-tree with an in-memory expected tree map, avoiding Git object writes.
Checks every tracked working-file blob and executable/symlink mode before and after focused validation.
Derives passing test totals from JUnit and rejects failures, errors, skips or empty collection.
Writes only a new private evidence directory outside all registered checkouts. Public proof copies remain byte-identical.
